authorization: Current broker policy; declarations do not grant permission.

commands.description: Open a URL in this chat's app-owned Gyro Browser, in the background by default. Prefer gyro_web_fetch for reading or summarizing a link; use the browser when rendered content, interaction, or visual evidence is needed. Set reveal: true for an explicit open/show request, a visual preview, or a user handoff such as sign-in. Use this—not OS-level computer control—when the user asks for Gyro's in-app or embedded browser. Any http(s) origin is allowed; navigation is gated by project policy (Ask by default) and remembered per origin for the session.

reveal.description: Show the Browser panel for an explicit open/show request, a visual preview, or a user handoff such as sign-in. Omit for background reading, research, or rendering fallback.

workflowNote: Illustrative browser interaction fixture, not the default for reading links. Prefer gyro_web_fetch for text-only research; reveal the browser only for an explicit open/show request, visual preview, or user handoff. Use the user's URL and observed references. Plan mode permits only operations allowed by its read-only policy.
